messages:
incident-bot: :warning: Alert: Elevated 5xx rate observed on /v1/stream (us-west-2 gateway cluster). Error breakdown: 502, 504, and TCP resets. Severity auto-assigned P2. On-call: @devon.

devon: ACK — I'm looking now. dashboards up, tail logs next. @sre-jen can you join for runtime logs?

sre-jen: grabbing logs. Spike starts ~18:42 UTC. 5xx rate ~8% (baseline ~0.2%). Top symptom: clients get partial chunks then connection close. Runtime gateway pods show upstream 502 and "write: broken pipe" in flush path.

infra-ryan: seeing increased gateway -> runtime LB timeouts as well; connection reuse and keepalive drops look suspicious.

devon: quick mitigation idea: disable chunked transfer encoding for streaming responses temporarily to see if it reduces client disconnects. How easy is that to toggle?

ops-bot: Command suggestion: `/infra/feature-flags toggle streaming.chunked_encoding false --env prod` (requires canary rollout ideally).

devon: good. before full flip let's canary at 10%. Also enable verbose logs for kvcache and chunked flush.

support-lee: Several paying customers reporting partial output + reconnects (example: Acme Corp, ticket #1123). Impact: degraded UX and retry storms.

sre-jen: snippet from runtime stderr:
```
2026-03-14T18:42:13Z runtime-gw-5fdc7 write: broken pipe
2026-03-14T18:42:13Z runtime-gw-5fdc7 error: upstream response 502 from model-worker-7
2026-03-14T18:42:14Z runtime-gw-5fdc7 trace: chunked flush 0xa3 failed: EPIPE
```

infra-ryan: I can open a small gateway timeout bump for a subset and/or route to a blue pool. Suggest: canary flag + 60->90s timeout for test group.

devon: agree. plan: 1) enable canary toggle at 10% (blue pool) 2) monitor errors for canary vs baseline 3) if errors drop, scale to 50% then 100% and keep disabled while we fix runtime write path.

product-anna: please prepare customer comms if mitigation affects streaming semantics. Support will need templated text.

support-lee: drafting status message and a note for SDK guidance (use idempotency tokens, backoff).

ops-bot: Feature flag canary started: streaming.chunked_encoding=false -> group: blue-10%.

sre-jen: initial canary results (2m): canary 10% errors down to 0.4%, non-canary still ~7-8%. Logs from canary show far fewer EPIPEs.

devon: good sign. increase canary to 50%.

ops-bot: Canary scaled: blue-50%.

sre-jen: after scaling to 50% aggregate 5xx dropped to ~2.5% and tail logs confirm chunked resets reduced.

infra-ryan: routing heavy customers (Acme + Beta) to canary pool to reduce impact. Doing manual route adjustments now.

support-lee: Acme routing updated; they report immediate improvement in stream stability.

devon: propose we flip to 100% disable chunked encoding as a temporary mitigation and then open an RCA/ticket to fix chunked write path in runtime (likely pipeline flush ordering + client cancel handling). Thoughts?

product-anna: acceptable as short-term. Need postmortem + ETA for runtime patch. Also confirm no major perf regression from non-chunked streams.

ops-bot: Feature flag updated: streaming.chunked_encoding=false -> 100% on prod.

sre-jen: monitoring: overall 5xx back to baseline ~0.3%. Latencies stable. No new alerts.

devon: excellent. creating follow-up ticket: RDW-6743 "Runtime: investigate chunked flush EPIPEs & client cancellations". Will own until fix merged.

devon: on-call handoff — I'm going off-call in 30m. Handover to @sre-jen for monitoring and RCA tracking.

sre-jen: ACK, I'll own the post-incident monitoring, RCA, and verify regression tests for streaming cancellation.

support-lee: status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1812345678 — customer message posted, ticket #1123 updated.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated (P2) — temporary mitigation applied: disabled chunked transfer encoding for streaming. Duration: 0h16m. Follow-ups: RDW-6743 (runtime), customer comms follow-up, postmortem triage.
